name: hikoo
description: Read AI search visibility data from a Hikoo account: citations, competitors, audits, AI-crawler traffic and content recommendations.

interface.longDescription:
Hikoo measures how a website shows up in the answers of AI assistants. This plugin connects to the Hikoo account the user already has, so they can ask about their own data in plain language.

What it can read: the workspaces and websites in the account; AI answers that cited the website and the source pages those answers relied on; competitors and their share of AI answers over time; sentiment; GEO and SEO audits of the website's pages; AI-crawler traffic and crawler access health; page indexation; tracked prompts and topics; and stored content-gap recommendations.

What it can change, always inside the user's own account and only with their confirmation: tracked prompts and topics, competitors and competitor suggestions, audits, health refreshes and suggestions, URL indexation requests, and shareable agency reports for workspaces that have them.

Sign-in uses OAuth with the user's Hikoo account. On the consent screen the user chooses read-only or read and write access, and can disconnect at any time from the API keys page in Hikoo.
defaultPrompt: Which AI assistants cite my website, and which sources do they rely on?
How do I compare with my competitors in AI answers this month?
What should I fix first to get cited more often?

publication.release_notes: Removes every Outreach tool: the plugin now only reads and manages AI visibility data inside the user's own Hikoo account, and never contacts anyone outside it.

fr-FR.subtitle: Visibilité IA et citations
fr-FR.description: Explorer les espaces de travail et les sites suivis dans Hikoo, consulter les citations IA, les concurrents, les audits, la santé pour les crawlers et les opportunités de contenu, et effectuer les actions autorisées sur le compte.

positive.description: Discover the account's websites and read real AI visibility.
positive.prompt: Which websites can you see in my Hikoo account, and how is spotify.com doing across AI assistants?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the workspaces and their websites, then reports spotify.com visibility per assistant from Hikoo. Asks which website to use if it is ambiguous rather than guessing.

positive.description: Recent citations and the source domains behind them.
positive.prompt: Show me the most recent answers where spotify.com was cited, and which sites those answers relied on.
positive.expected_behavior: Recent citations with the assistant that produced each, and the source domains Hikoo recorded, such as tomsguide.com and whathifi.com.

positive.prompt: How does spotify.com compare with Apple Music and Tidal in AI answers over the last month?
positive.expected_behavior: A comparison over the period with figures per competitor, every one of them returned by a tool and none invented.

positive.description: Add a competitor after checking the remaining quota and confirming the write.
positive.prompt: Add Deezer (https://www.deezer.com) as a competitor for spotify.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirm the requested account change because the tool declares destructiveHint, then create the competitor and report the result.

positive.description: Get content recommendations for a tracked website from its stored content-gap analysis.
positive.prompt: What content should I write based on Hikoo recommendations?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the stored content-gap suggestions for the website, each with its topic, content type and priority, and explain which to write first and why. All recommendations come from the server; none are invented.

negative.description: General marketing question that needs no account data.
negative.prompt: What is the difference between SEO and generative engine optimization?

negative.description: Writing task with no website or account data involved.
negative.prompt: Write a short tweet announcing our new podcast season.

negative.description: Data from a different product. Hikoo holds no Google Search Console, Google Analytics or keyword-ranking data.
negative.prompt: Show me my Google Search Console impressions and average position for last week.
